stem.text: Which statements about mitochondria, chloroplasts or prokaryotes are correct?

items: Mitochondria and chloroplasts have a fully permeable inner membrane and a partially permeable outer membrane.
Prokaryotes and chloroplasts have 70S ribosomes that are the sites for translation and polypeptide synthesis.
Prokaryotes and mitochondria have an outer membrane and an inner, folded membrane where ATP synthesis occurs.
Prokaryotes and mitochondria have circular DNA where genes coding for information are located.
